title: All GTA 6 Animals And Wildlife Spawn Locations
summary: You can go birdwatching in GTA 6 . Seriously. You can put aside that life of crime and take up the rather harmless hobby of logging new birds. It's not just birds, as there are reptiles, mammals, and marine animals in every county of the state of Leonida. Some are exotic, others common, and even some non-native creatures that are just plain weird to see here. Of course, you don't have to look for critters in GTA 6. Plenty of other side activities that aren't main missions are worth indulging in, such as finding all the WAiNK Sculptures and WAiNK landmarks , and reading all the magazines, books, and comics scattered throughout Leonida. You can even track down missing people if you've run out of animals to go hunting for. In This Article How to log Wildlife sightings How many of each animal are there? How to log Wildlife sightings There are three ways to log your sightings of each animal in GTA 6. The first is for any creature that is close to you. You can focus by holding L2/LT, then press and hold R1/RB to study that animal. Once you fill the circle, that creature will be logged in your wildlife sighting progression track, which you can look at by opening the sub-menu. If you'd rather not get up close and personal with an alligator, or if you're trying to track the many bird species in Leonida, you can equip the binoculars from your weapon wheel. You can zoom in using the D-Pad, but you'll need to track that animal as you use the Study prompt. This is certainly easier said than done, particularly for small or fast birds, but you'll eventually get the hang of it. Finally, for any fishing-related animal sightings, you need to catch them with a fishing rod. One of the early missions in Chapter 1 teaches you everything you need to know about catching fish. Essentially, you cast out the line, reel it back in slowly to tempt a fish to bite, then, once you have one on the hook, you tire it out by pulling on the line in the opposite direction. Once you're holding it, it will be added to your log. If you want to catch the bigger fish in the area, you'll need more lures, which are sold at some Ammu-Nations. Use the map to browse through the stores that sell lures. Not every one will have a full inventory, so make sure you get the type you need for the waters you're fishing in. You'll need to search up high in the sky and deep beneath the ocean to log every animal. How many of each animal are there? Wildlife is split into several categories Hunting - 61 species Fishing - 35 species Mammals - 18 species Cats & Dogs - 34 species Reptiles & Amphibians - 6 species Birds - 60 species Aquatic - 18 species Other - 23 species Not all birds are just going to sit there, allowing you to study them up close. All GTA 6 Wildlife locations While many species are found throughout Leonida, a handful are region-specific.
